mission.title: The mission.
mission.text: AI, cyber and code, for jobs in Madagascar.

s3.desc: Everyone starts with programming fundamentals, in Java and JavaScript. Then two paths: Software Ecosystem to build robust, secure applications, and Digital Transformation to make data work for businesses.

s4.desc: Every theoretical concept comes with a hands-on project. After three years in the LMD system: a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science recognised by MESupRES.
